We have for $x \geq 912560$,
  \[
  \sum_{p \leq x} \frac{\log p}{p} = \log x - B_3 + O^*\Bigl(\frac{0.3}{\log^2 x}\Bigr),
  \]
  where $B_3 \approx 1.33258$ is the constant from \cite[Theorem 5.7]{Dusart2018}.
